description: Write a draft, judge it, and feed the judge's reason back into the next attempt until the judge passes it, at most five attempts and USD 0.05. The scripted writer (test:refine) answers {"draft": "attempt <attempt + 1>", "after": <feedback>}, and the scripted judge (test:judge) passes when the draft contains the quoted MUST_CONTAIN text, so the loop passes on the third attempt. The USD 0.05 cap only bites under a price file that prices test:* models (config/model-prices.test.json); under the default price file both models cost $0, the cap never stops the loop, and publish warns cost_cap_unpriced_model.

writer.name: Release note writer
writer.instructions: Write a one-line release note. If feedback is given, revise the draft to address it.

evaluators.rubric: The release note must say which attempt it is. MUST_CONTAIN:"attempt 3"
